eps.t: The Case of the Lost Condors
eps.o: When three baby condors go missing on a volcano, Sam and Kit battle falling rocks, strong winds and hot lava to save the chicks before a giant eruption.

eps.t: The Danger in the Lion's Den
eps.o: When two cubs get mixed up, the CLADE team must stay quiet as they enter a lion's den to rescue a young leopard -- without waking the king of the jungle.

eps.t: The Secret of the Stinky Fruit
eps.o: A troop of monkeys are stunned when their delicious but stinky durian fruit vanishes. To track it down, Sam and Kit call on a trusty pal: Wally Bungler.

eps.t: The Puzzle of the Panicking Penguins
eps.o: Sea serpents aren't real...or are they? When a slithery figure scares a colony of blue penguins, Sam and Kit look for answers from some scaly suspects.

eps.t: The Hunt for the Hot Spring
eps.o: Sam and Kit visit the Asian tundra to try and help a group of grumpy macaques find a new place to relax after their favorite hot spring goes cold.
When Sam and Kit get trapped in a cave, it's up to the Mice Squad to become detectives as they search for a shadowy figure who stole their music gear.
The whole CLADE team is on high alert when Detective Scratch's birthday present goes missing. Can they track down her gift before the big surprise party?

eps.t: The Search for the Enormous Snake
eps.o: When a gigantic snake interrupts movie night for everyone, Sam and Kit team up with an animal-tracking bobcat named Robert. But can they trust him?
The team rushes to the South American jungle to solve a slimy mystery when a spooky swamp monster throws all the pond animals into a panic.

eps.t: The Case of the Travelling Twigs
eps.o: After odd sounds throw the Oak Tree Jam Band out of tune, the Mice Squad investigates -- and uncovers a family of peculiar creatures making funny noises.
